blocks.title: Operators and expressions
blocks.text: Operators are symbols that perform operations on variables and values. An expression is a combination of variables, operators and values that produces a result.
Python has arithmetic, comparison, assignment and logical operators, and rules of precedence decide which operation in an expression is done first.

blocks.prompt: Is 3 + 4 an operator or an expression?
blocks.explanation: An expression: + is the operator, 3 and 4 are values, and together they produce the result 7.

items: Operators act on values; expressions combine them to give a result; four families: arithmetic, comparison, assignment, logical.
